overall: The AG found the Everett City Council violated the Open Meeting Law because none of its eleven members had properly completed the required certification of receipt, and ordered compliance and completion of the forms within 30 days.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that all Council members failed to sign the required Open Meeting Law certification form, as G.L. c. 30A, § 20(h) requires.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law where all of its members failed to comply with the certification requirements of the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Each member who has not yet completed the certification form must complete it and file it with the City Clerk within 30 days of the date of the letter.
remedy_passage: We order the Council’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and note that future similar violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the law. Additionally, we order each member who has not yet completed the certification form to complete the form and file it with the City Clerk within 30 days of the date of this letter.
